scope: Free without a policy or requirement preserves the original prompt and queue paths.
Managed prompt serializes only the same exact Agent and rpcId, checking original accepted receipt after waiting and before publication.
Immutable exact prompt candidates are built after attachments await; managed queue-edit rechecks the exact previous item and target before replacement.
The publisher callback dispatch is synchronous and single-use during the awaited policy; NativeWorkInput supplies the final exact-payload admission.
Managed queue-steer is deliberately unavailable until a separate trusted accepted-input continuation is implemented; the old item is retained.
Seed/fork/replay and subagent initial composition are outside this patch.
The admission holder is immutable at runtime and shared by scoped service receivers.
Managed old-receipt lookup verifies the owned exact Agent/Session and excludes inherited user history; Free keeps the original upstream receipt semantics.
